mapper.sql: m.id, m.student_id, m.academic_term, m.total_score, m.rank_in_class, m.grade_level, m.detail_json, m.computed_at, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, COALESCE(sp.student_no, u.student_id) AS student_no, COALESCE(NULLIF(sp.class_name, ''), '未填班级') AS class_name, sp.major, sp.grade, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.real_name, ''), c.username) AS counselor_name
FROM eval_summary m LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = m.student_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = m.student_id AND sp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users c ON c.id = sp.counselor_id
ORDER BY class_name, m.rank_in_class IS NULL, m.rank_in_class, m.total_score DESC, m.student_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eval_summary (student_id, academic_term, total_score, rank_in_class, grade_level, detail_json, computed_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{academicTerm}, #{totalScore}, #{rankInClass}, #{gradeLevel}, #{detailJson}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_score = VALUES(total_score), rank_in_class = VALUES(rank_in_class), grade_level = VALUES(grade_level), detail_json = VALUES(detail_json), computed_at = NOW()
